agents.name: specification-manager
agents.selection_guide: Call to configure HAI specification enablement and location, or enter, update, organize, or validate durable product specification information. Returns validated settings, changes, verification evidence, and unresolved decisions.

agents.name: agent-definition-manager
agents.selection_guide: Call to create, maintain, validate or audit workspace agent definitions and reusable source packages against conventions. New agents default to workspace origin. Returns verified definition changes, findings and metadata for runtime; creation does not install or register a package.

agents.name: business-analyst
agents.selection_guide: Call to clarify business intent, analyze requirements and define scope and acceptance criteria. Returns attributable requirements, decisions, ambiguities and evidence for host coordinator and the Activity record owner.

agents.name: solution-architect
agents.selection_guide: Call to analyze technical options, design a solution and plan implementation and verification against agreed requirements. Returns justified architecture, tradeoffs, dependencies, risks and an actionable plan.

agents.name: software-developer
agents.selection_guide: Call to implement authorized product changes and run appropriate developer checks against agreed requirements and technical decisions. Returns actual changes, verification evidence, failures and unresolved dependencies.

agents.name: quality-assurance
agents.selection_guide: Call to verify product behavior against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria, assess regressions and report evidence-based defects and coverage limits. Returns actual test results and unresolved acceptance risks.

agents.name: backlog-manager
agents.selection_guide: Call to configure a workspace backlog location, capture or import backlog items, maintain their catalogue, prepare an item for Activity work, and record evidence-backed completion, cancellation or rejection. Returns item paths, status changes, catalogue checks and unresolved decisions.
